commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git fetch --no-tags origin chore/mvp-final-closeout-20261123
test "$(git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/chore/mvp-final-closeout-20261123)" = "95ca29263d7abc86b3e3c871cdb36f47aff1e920"
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
TMP="$(mktemp -d /tmp/aicalls-mvp-docs-XXXXXX)"
trap 'cd "$ROOT"; git worktree remove --force "$TMP" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
git worktree add --detach "$TMP" "95ca29263d7abc86b3e3c871cdb36f47aff1e920"
cd "$TMP"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "95ca29263d7abc86b3e3c871cdb36f47aff1e920"
bash scripts/bin/test-profile.sh preflight
PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m unittest scripts.tests.test_docs_check
test ! -e docs/images/settings.png
test ! -e docs/images/model-and-voice.png
echo "MVP_FINAL_CLEANUP_PREFLIGHT_PASS=true"
echo "QA_SHA=95ca29263d7abc86b3e3c871cdb36f47aff1e920"
